OmaTasks now has an All tab, so a task without a date outside Inbox finally has a place in the panel. The panel also reopens on the tab you left it on, j and k move through your tasks, and the panel opens under replacement bars such as Station.

<img width="492" alt="The All tab in the light theme: tasks grouped under Inbox, Pro and Planning, dated or not" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/78bc2465-11fc-4cbf-b75b-c088a8d65b6a" />
<img width="492" alt="The same All tab in the dark theme" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/098bd0bb-259d-4807-82ce-d52cf98132a7" />

## New

- **An All tab for every task.** A fourth tab after Upcoming lists every active task, dated or not, grouped by project, so tasks without a date outside Inbox are no longer missing from the panel. It keeps the assignee, priority, label, deadline and folder filters, dragging a task reorders it within its project, never by date, and a task added there gets no date. The tabs now size to their labels, and the default panel width is 460px, with 440px the smallest, so no label is cut. By @joemugen (Joe FRANCOIS) in [#23](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/pull/23).
- **The panel reopens on the tab you left it on.** Leave it on Inbox or All and that is where it opens next time, also after the shell restarts and on another monitor's bar. By @thenitai (Nitai) in [#9](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/pull/9).
- **Move through your tasks with j and k.** As in Omarchy's own panels, **j** or **↓** and **k** or **↑** move a highlight through the tasks, and **Enter** or **Space** opens the highlighted task. The list scrolls to keep it in view. By @crmne; thanks @seshna for [#1](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/issues/1).

  <img width="497" alt="The Today panel with the third task, Polish the launch demo, highlighted by the keyboard cursor, in the light theme" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/139e6c1a-af6c-430d-8e26-349bb81d9224" />
  <img width="497" alt="The same keyboard highlight in the dark theme" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6b662959-5e74-49db-ad28-4eb8d6a0bca7" />

## Fixed

- **The panel opens under replacement bars.** Under a bar such as Station, clicking the icon did nothing and the bar showed no count, because Omarchy gives widgets there no access to the plugin's service. The widget now finds the service the plugin publishes, so the click opens the panel and the count and next task show again. By @thenitai in [#27](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/pull/27).
- **The folder filter follows your theme on Qt 6.12.** The folder checklist from 1.4.3 missed the Qt 6.12 palette fix from 1.4.0, so on Qt 6.12 its rows fell back to white with black names and its checkboxes lost their borders, whatever your theme. By @crmne.
- **The bar icon matches Omarchy's icons.** It is now the size of Omarchy's other bar icons and centred on the count beside it, instead of slightly larger and sitting a little high. By @crmne; thanks @atsyplenkov and @caniswim for the feedback in [#5](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/issues/5).

## Known limitations

- Under a replacement bar, restart the shell once after updating (`omarchy restart shell`): the running service keeps its old code until then, so the panel does not open yet. The built-in bar needs nothing.
- The All tab lists every active task the plugin syncs. It has not been tried with an account holding several thousand tasks.

## Validation

146 JavaScript tests, 24 composer UI checks, 21 list interaction checks, 7 folder filter checks, 7 bar checks, and 6 All tab checks passed. QML parsing, shell syntax checks, and Omarchy plugin validation also passed. `tests/check-bar` now also hosts the widget the way a replacement bar does, with a shell that offers no service, and checks that a click opens the panel; it was not tried under Station itself. `tests/check-drag` drives j, k, the arrow keys, Enter and Space offscreen, and `tests/check-folder` checks that the folder checklist follows the theme's palette. The keyboard screenshots use synthetic tasks rendered offscreen from the real QML components on the GPU, and the All tab screenshots are @joemugen's, also with synthetic tasks.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omatasks.git --enable
```

Requires Omarchy Quattro and a Todoist account. Existing users can update the plugin through Omarchy.
